security_audit.summary: The command-execution alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, and the credential alerts are ordinary parameters or a localhost Redis example. The skill does perform network requests and writes intercepted responses to disk. High-risk semantic concerns include anti-bot circumvention guidance and capture of potentially sensitive application traffic.

remediation.issue: The skill teaches CAPTCHA bypass, browser fingerprint concealment, proxy rotation, WAF avoidance, and disabling robots.txt enforcement.
remediation.suggestion: Remove circumvention instructions, keep robots.txt enforcement enabled, and require documented authorization and target-specific rate limits.

remediation.issue: The mitmproxy examples print request headers and bodies and save complete responses, which may expose credentials or personal data.
remediation.suggestion: Redact authorization data, minimize captured fields, encrypt retained data, set restrictive permissions, and require explicit authorization before interception.

remediation.issue: The proxy pool downloads a mutable public proxy list and routes requests through untrusted hosts.
remediation.suggestion: Use a trusted authenticated proxy provider, verify source integrity, restrict destinations, and never send credentials through untrusted proxies.

remediation.issue: Captured response bodies are written under filenames derived from request paths without retention or sensitivity controls.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize filenames, enforce a fixed output directory, use restrictive permissions, redact sensitive content, and define automatic retention limits.

content.value_statement: Collecting reliable data from static pages, dynamic sites, and APIs requires several tools and careful engineering. This skill provides implementation templates for extraction, cleaning, storage, monitoring, and scaling.
actual_capabilities: Creates request and parsing patterns for static pages with Requests, Beautiful Soup, lxml, and Parsel.
Builds Playwright workflows for dynamic rendering, selector waits, scrolling, and browser-based extraction.
Provides Scrapy templates with pagination, retries, delays, pipelines, and distributed Redis scheduling.
Cleans, deduplicates, validates, and stores collected records with pandas and MongoDB examples.
Demonstrates authorized application traffic inspection and response capture with mitmproxy.
Adds health checks, record-count monitoring, failure detection, and data quality reports.
limitations: Examples require target-specific selectors, schemas, authentication, and error handling before production use.
The skill does not grant permission to collect data or guarantee legal and contractual compliance.
Browser automation, databases, proxies, and distributed queues require separate installation and infrastructure.
Anti-bot techniques may violate site policies and should not be used without explicit authorization.

use_cases.title: Collect Public Research Data
use_cases.description: Build a rate-limited collector for permitted public pages, then normalize and validate the extracted records.

use_cases.title: Automate Dynamic Catalog Extraction
use_cases.description: Use Playwright to load dynamic product pages, handle scrolling, and extract changing catalog fields.

use_cases.title: Operate a Scalable Collection Pipeline
use_cases.description: Design Scrapy workers, Redis scheduling, storage, monitoring, retries, and data quality controls for authorized sources.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Scraper
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a polite scraper for [URL] that extracts [fields]. Respect robots.txt, use a one-second delay, and return a table.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs structured data from a permitted static page.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Dynamic Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Playwright scraper for [URL]. Wait for [selector], handle scrolling or pagination, extract [fields], and include retries and structured logs.
prompt_templates.scenario: A JavaScript-rendered page loads records after user interaction.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Data Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Scrapy pipeline for [domain] with deduplication, incremental updates, validation, and [database] storage. Keep robots.txt enforcement enabled.
prompt_templates.scenario: A recurring collection job needs reliable storage and data quality controls.

prompt_templates.title: Architect Distributed Collection
prompt_templates.prompt: Architect an authorized collector for [sources] at [volume]. Include rate limits, queueing, observability, recovery, data lineage, privacy controls, and capacity estimates.
prompt_templates.scenario: A platform team needs a production design for multiple approved sources.

output_examples.input: Extract article titles, publication dates, and links from an approved news archive.
output_examples.output: A normalized table with title, publication date, source link, validation status, and collection timestamp.

output_examples.input: Design a recurring collector for a permitted dynamic catalog with daily updates.
output: Playwright extraction flow with stable selector guidance
Rate limits, retries, logs, and health checks
Validated records prepared for database storage

output_examples.input: Assess a proposed Scrapy deployment for several authorized sources.
output_examples.output: A deployment plan covering workers, Redis scheduling, storage, monitoring, failure recovery, data validation, and source-specific limits.

best_practices: Confirm authorization, service terms, robots.txt rules, privacy limits, and retention requirements before collecting data.
Start with small samples, conservative concurrency, explicit timeouts, retries, and source-specific rate limits.
Preserve data lineage, validate required fields, monitor structural changes, and redact sensitive logs.
anti_patterns: Do not bypass CAPTCHA, WAF, authentication, or browser controls without explicit written authorization.
Do not route credentials or sensitive records through public proxies or unverified infrastructure.
Do not store raw intercepted traffic without redaction, encryption, restrictive permissions, and retention limits.

faq.question: Can this skill scrape JavaScript-rendered pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides Playwright patterns for loading pages, waiting for selectors, scrolling, and extracting rendered content.

faq.question: Does it support API collection?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes paginated request patterns, optional bearer authentication, timeouts, response validation, and record aggregation.

faq.question: Can it build distributed crawlers?
faq.answer: It provides Scrapy and Redis scheduling examples, but production infrastructure, capacity planning, and operations remain your responsibility.

faq.question: Does the skill ensure scraping is legal?
faq.answer: No. You must verify authorization, service terms, robots.txt rules, privacy obligations, copyright, and local laws.

faq.question: Can it inspect application traffic?
faq.answer: It includes mitmproxy examples for authorized testing. Captured headers, bodies, and responses may contain sensitive data and require protection.

faq.question: What must be customized before use?
faq.answer: Configure domains, selectors, schemas, authentication, storage, rate limits, retries, monitoring, privacy controls, and retention policies.
